title: FTP server restarts automatically after being stopped and the app is closed

full_report.title: FTP server restarts automatically after being stopped and the app is closed
full_report.observed_behavior: On the FTP server screen, if the user turns off the FTP server switch and then closes the app, the FTP server restarts automatically after stopping it and closing the app.
full_report.expected_behavior: The FTP server should stay stopped after stopping it and closing the app.
full_report.steps_to_reproduce:
1. Open the app. <aa09f6aef3409759f67d672c9efcbd64d8f3b0ee61cf3e8d197f0539e34430d2>
2. Grant the storage permission by tapping Allow. <9253ef287211a96261d15d2522d1499f880b411f5e49851b98bae34f3403ab9d>
3. Open the navigation drawer from the main Files screen. <3abd760d81519f7d0b2fe5daa74c918b40f9496bef2bf776dd7b0d8e95a47b49>
4. Select FTP server from the navigation drawer. <ed4ddd149d2da1bda9c6a957048313602988bce3f183bd199efeacece662aeec>
5. On the FTP server screen, tap the ON switch to stop the FTP server. <8453ee6186ad267c55c0f443ad2d1644911453cf4f005a06837b415345db6be5>
6. Close the app by pressing Back from the FTP server screen. <944abf1e97748f2436418aea5aa65a35e80ea307f807f0264ae85d2c80188e7c>
